text:
maria: Quick brainstorm — webinar idea: "Inference ops playbook: SLAs, cost levers, and guardrails". We need a clear CTA and a short demo. Thoughts?

ada: Strong. Ops framing should pull platform leads. CTA: evaluation kit + pilot signup.

toni: Agree. I'll run a small LinkedIn test. Need landing page + 2 subject lines.

prashant: I can present 10-12min on batching, caching, and routing with one fallback code snippet. Will prepare a 60s pre-recorded demo as backup.

kevin: Design note: 16:9 slide deck, single resource slide with QR to the kit. I'll mock a 20s GIF showing routing. Need headshots by Tue.

maria: Proposed run-of-show (40m): 0:00-0:03 intro, 0:03-0:18 tech playbook (prashant), 0:18-0:26 customer vignette, 0:26-0:29 pre-recorded demo, 0:29-0:37 live Q&A, 0:37-0:40 CTAs + resources.

toni: Lead routing: hidden field source=webinar_ops_playbook, tag=webinar_ops. Engagement rules: asked Q or watched >50% -> AE, others -> nurture. I'll implement HubSpot mapping.

prashant: Tech checklist for stream: mic check, PDF backup, demo MP4 uploaded, host spotlight rights. I'll upload assets by Wed.

ada: Promo timeline: announce (wk -3), paid (wk -2), reminders (wk -1), day-of reminders 2h and 15m. We'll include a conservative bench claim in copy with methodology note.

kevin: Will share slide template and resource slide v0 Monday.

ops-bot: Webinar infra OK: recording enabled, polls active, max attendees 2k.

maria: Action items: prashant slides+demo (Wed), kevin assets+QR (Mon), toni HubSpot + paid brief (Tue), ada sign-off on copy (Thu). Rehearsals: tech check 10m before, dry run 2 days prior, dress run 1 day prior.

ada: One more — prepare a 3-bullet FAQ for SDRs and three persona-specific talking points. Alex from Sales will finalize.

maria: Great. I'll open the registration page draft and drop copy here. Closing loop after dress run. :rocket:
